# The Trusted gate's allowlist (src/health_data_registry/ratchet.py; docs/dev/README.md#the-trusted-gate).
#
# A pull request that adds a skip, skipif or xfail mark, a test deselection or pytest -m/-k filter, a no-cover or
# no-mutate pragma, a mutmut exclusion, a type-ignore or noqa comment, an inline mypy setting, a ruff, mypy,
# coverage or pytest relaxation, a relaxing command-line flag or a command whose failure is ignored, a new condition
# on a required job or step, a weakened mutation job, a removed pre-commit hook, or that removes a test, fails the
# Trusted gate unless its entry is listed here first. The gate's failure message prints the exact entry after
# "Allowlist entry:"; copy what follows it.
#
# This file changes only in a pull request that changes nothing else, and the gate reads it from main: an entry
# counts only once its own pull request has been through the review round and merged.
#
# One entry per line: <path> :: <the line, stripped of leading and trailing spaces>
# A removed test is listed as: <path at the merge base> :: def <test name>
# A test with fewer parametrized cases is listed the same way: <path at the merge base> :: def <test name>
# A new condition on a required job or step is listed as: <workflow path> :: if: <condition, spaces collapsed>
# A mutation job: <workflow> :: job <id> | needs <job> -> <mutation job> | schedule <cron> | <job>: <command>
# A removed pre-commit hook: .pre-commit-config.yaml :: hook <id>
# Say why in a comment above each entry.
